pa:2610.32046.name: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
pa:2610.32046.desc: Test-Time Memory Evolution updates external memory without changing model weights to guide scientific discovery more efficiently than test-time training.

pa:2610.35864.name: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
pa:2610.35864.desc: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos via code, finding that top systems meet core requirements on most tasks but frequently fail due to poor time management.
pa:2610.35864.zh: 評測AI自動寫程式做影片的能力與表現
pa:2610.35864.why: 測試AI用寫程式來製作影片的實力，發現頂尖系統能達成基本要求，但常因時間掌控不好而失敗

pa:2610.36791.name: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
pa:2610.36791.desc: RynnWorld-Latent learns cross-embodiment world dynamics via 3D-grounded latent actions, enabling joint pretraining on diverse video sources and synthetic data generation for improved robot policy performance.

pa:2610.37381.name: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
pa:2610.37381.desc: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.
pa:2610.37381.zh: 讓機器人懂物理規律，動作更流暢自然
pa:2610.37381.why: 結合物理動態預測模組，讓機器人不用耗時生成影片也能快速做出準確動作

pa:2610.37255.name: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
pa:2610.37255.desc: Under KL-regularized control, a policy encodes its harness preferences, so deployed performance equals harness potential minus policy mismatch, and harness comparisons must separate these terms to predict training gains.

pa:2610.34674.name: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
pa:2610.34674.desc: The study introduces a benchmark and metric to evaluate whether robot navigation policies adapt continuous motion to obstacle safety semantics, revealing a gap in translating semantic caution into safe movement.

pa:2610.36077.name: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
pa:2610.36077.desc: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.
pa:2610.36077.zh: 讓多功能AI自己出題練習並不斷升級
pa:2610.36077.why: 透過自動建立模擬訓練環境和能力樹，讓AI能自己學習成長，在各種測試中表現更好

pa:2610.34921.name: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
pa:2610.34921.desc: Physevolve trains vision-language models in causal physical reasoning by using a physics engine to validate self-generated executable worlds and counterfactual simulations, improving performance on dynamics benchmarks without human data.

pa:2610.26185.name: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
pa:2610.26185.desc: MoveBench introduces a specialized benchmark for evaluating large language models on sports and health coaching, emphasizing safety, scientific validity, and personalization across multiple-choice and open-ended tasks.

pa:2610.37175.name: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
pa:2610.37175.desc: A world model predicts machine learning program outcomes to enable affordable test-time scaling for AI research agents, improving performance with fewer real executions.

pa:2610.37219.name: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
pa:2610.37219.desc: Just Action Model decouples backbone initialization, future observation objectives, and inference machinery to improve robot control with foresight training and reduced computation.

pa:2610.37585.name: Timestral
pa:2610.37585.desc: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.

pa:2610.36022.name: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
pa:2610.36022.desc: GeoUG improves spatial reasoning by combining depth and multi-view generation with adaptive geometric verification during inference.

pa:2610.37386.name: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
pa:2610.37386.desc: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.

pa:2610.33066.name: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
pa:2610.33066.desc: OvisOCR3 is a compact 0.8B vision-language model that unifies diverse OCR tasks through multi-teacher distillation and reinforcement learning, achieving state-of-the-art results across document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction, figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction.

pa:2610.37341.name: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
pa:2610.37341.desc: Executable code representations of video content improve reasoning and reconstruction over natural language, yet current multimodal models still struggle to generate faithful code captions for complex temporal dynamics.

pa:2610.34073.name: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
pa:2610.34073.desc: Large-scale evaluation reveals that dedicated memory systems often underperform naive retrieval-augmented generation, introducing a framework of memory benefit and memory tax to assess net value.

pa:2610.37666.name: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
pa:2610.37666.desc: ThinkWorld improves robotic generalization by representing actions as dynamics chains and using world imagination to learn from unlabeled human videos.
pa:2610.37666.zh: 讓機器人透過想像力模擬動作，學會處理各種複雜環境
pa:2610.37666.why: 讓機器人看過人類影片後，能在大腦中模擬動作細節，不用真人手把手教也能學會

pa:2610.35724.name: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
pa:2610.35724.desc: MatAnyone-E accelerates high-resolution video matting by selectively applying high-resolution matching to uncertain regions and using a lightweight decoder, achieving large speedups with preserved quality.

pa:2610.35439.name: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
pa:2610.35439.desc: Omni-InteractScope evaluates continuous audiovisual interaction reliability, revealing that current Omni-LLMs struggle with timely tool use, query-free reminders, and sustained guidance.

pa:2610.24520.name: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
pa:2610.24520.desc: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether LLM agent memory systems can infer implicit user habits from sparse dialogue evidence and apply them correctly across long-term interactions.

pa:2610.34714.name: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
pa:2610.34714.desc: SearchHorizonBench evaluates how agents learn to estimate the value of additional search from execution history, showing that historical calibration improves prediction accuracy but leaves most search-gain variance unexplained.

pa:2610.36729.name: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
pa:2610.36729.desc: Hy-Nomas is a video world model that uses causal attention and structured conditioning to generate interactive, multi-turn video segments with text and camera control.
pa:2610.36729.zh: 支援文字與鏡頭控制的互動式影片模型
pa:2610.36729.why: 可以用文字和鏡頭操作，連續產生多段可以互動的動態影片世界

pa:2610.37649.name: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
pa:2610.37649.desc: LongChang evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously discover altered physical laws through simulated experimentation, finding that only one model achieved limited success.

pa:2610.34724.name: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
pa:2610.34724.desc: HaMo combines rapid retrieval of procedural experience cards with gradual model adaptation to improve long-horizon web agents' retention and cross-task execution.

pa:2610.34491.name: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
pa:2610.34491.desc: Reasoning effort in generative models acts as a credence good where higher compute does not guarantee better instance-level results, and an escalation strategy from low effort improves cost-efficiency.

pa:2610.36420.name: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
pa:2610.36420.desc: A simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost robot arms reveals that hybrid LLM agents outperform learned vision-language-action policies, with ranking consistency between simulation and real hardware.

pa:2610.35013.why: 改善多步驟任務的訓練方式，讓 AI 在長期規劃時表現更穩定聰明

pa:2610.35962.name: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
pa:2610.35962.desc: A simple agentic loop with efficient Lean feedback achieves state-of-the-art formal theorem proving without structured workflows, showing that execution interfaces matter more than complex orchestration.

pa:2602.10657.name: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
pa:2602.10657.desc: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.

pa:2610.37037.name: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
pa:2610.37037.desc: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.

pa:2610.37662.name: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
pa:2610.37662.desc: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.

pa:2610.26030.name: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
pa:2610.26030.desc: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.

pa:2610.37624.name: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
pa:2610.37624.desc: When compressing multi-agent discussions for final decisions, memory selection by rarity or relevance both fail due to decoy inclusion and social-proof bias, and even full transcripts reduce accuracy compared to no notes.

pa:2610.31924.name: Sub-monolayer tracking of molecular states at buried interfaces
pa:2610.31924.desc: Machine learning-enhanced optical modeling of polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering enables quantitative, depth-resolved analysis of molecular orientation and packing at buried interfaces.

pa:2610.36184.name: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
pa:2610.36184.desc: Lipi-Ghor is a large-scale weakly supervised Bengali speech corpus with speaker-diarized long-form annotations and a gold evaluation split for benchmarking ASR models.

pa:2610.36192.name: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
pa:2610.36192.desc: Wiener-informed Decoding accelerates pixel-space velocity model training and improves image generation by integrating statistical predictions into decoder computation without altering native blocks.

pa:2610.34894.name: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
pa:2610.34894.desc: Reinforcement learning improves pass@1 mainly by finishing answers faster and increasing reliability rather than acquiring new problem-solving knowledge, with minimal reach gains under fixed token budgets.

pa:2610.36082.name: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
pa:2610.36082.desc: Fin-SD improves local multi-step financial reasoning by using self-generated error critiques and truncated correct prefixes for on-policy distillation without external teachers.

pa:2610.37364.name: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
pa:2610.37364.desc: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that unifies text, images, audio, and video representations with efficient resource-flexible design and state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

pa:2610.33245.name: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
pa:2610.33245.desc: AdaPRA improves data science agents via persistent knowledge accumulation and adaptive rubric-guided process supervision, reducing errors and boosting leaderboard performance.

pa:2610.30435.name: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
pa:2610.30435.desc: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning trains search agents to recognize missing information and improve search efficiency without extra inference-time assessment.

pa:2509.05512.name: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
pa:2509.05512.desc: QUAN is a quaternion-based deep learning framework that approximates quaternion convolution with real-valued operations to achieve rotation-equivariant image classification and object detection with improved efficiency.

pa:2610.22684.name: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
pa:2610.22684.desc: AlphaBet uses agentic reinforcement learning to train a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report forecast probabilities across multiple dates, reducing Brier scores by improving both evidence acquisition and probability reporting.

hf:OliviaRossi/Minimax-h3_Singularity-x-.name: OliviaRossi/Minimax-h3_Singularity-x-10Eros-Max_PRISM

pa:2601.15351.name: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
pa:2601.15351.desc: OmniSpectra is a wavelength-native spectral foundation model that uses continuous coordinates and physics-grounded decoders to learn cross-instrument representations without destructive resampling, achieving high performance with far fewer parameters.

pa:2610.31670.name: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
pa:2610.31670.desc: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.

pa:2610.37230.name: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
pa:2610.37230.desc: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.
pa:2610.37230.zh: 幫AI助理聰明安排工作排程，讓多個任務同時跑更快

pa:2610.35684.name: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
pa:2610.35684.desc: OmniShowcase improves subject-to-video generation by using geometry-driven training data and surface-normal conditioning to maintain 3D consistency across novel viewpoints.

pa:2610.35684.why: 能從多個角度的照片，做出主角保持一致且符合三維空間的流暢影片

pa:2610.32749.name: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
pa:2610.32749.desc: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.
pa:2610.32749.zh: 能在吵雜環境中即時清出特定人聲的輕量系統
pa:2610.32749.why: 大幅降低運算資源與延遲，在真實複雜的聲音環境中也能精準抓出你想聽的那個人聲

pa:2610.22507.name: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
pa:2610.22507.desc: REALCLI is a benchmark that jointly evaluates CLI agent task execution and human-agent collaboration quality, revealing major gaps in steerability, trust calibration, and safety management.

pa:2610.30132.name: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
pa:2610.30132.desc: LongZero enables large language models to self-improve long-context reasoning by synthesizing structured multi-hop and retrieval tasks and training with GRPO without external data.

pa:2610.30161.name: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
pa:2610.30161.desc: TauIndianBankBench evaluates language model assistants on Indian retail banking by verifying both procedural compliance and final outcomes across 1,000 simulated tasks.

pa:2610.29702.name: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
pa:2610.29702.desc: CausGround extracts reusable action preconditions and effects from interaction experience to improve embodied planning and reasoning across diverse environments without model retraining.

pa:2610.34186.name: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
pa:2610.34186.desc: HuGe pre-trains vision-language-action models on egocentric human and robot data with pseudo-proprioception and visual adaptation to enable whole-body humanoid control.

sp:hugging-apps/hi3dv1.zh: Hi3Dv1 的線上互動展示空間，提供圖片轉 3D 的網頁端直接體驗

pa:2610.35671.name: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
pa:2610.35671.desc: Independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 reveals substantial improvements over prior versions and near-parity with leading closed-source models, while recommending process-level observability, incremental safety testing, and private benchmarks.

pa:2610.20832.name: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
pa:2610.20832.desc: Large language models learn adaptive information gathering by training reasoning with information-gain rewards, improving experimental design efficiency and generalizing across tasks.

pa:2610.33645.name: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
pa:2610.33645.desc: PreView is an auxiliary preprocessor that enhances GUI grounding by providing localized zoomed views and visual-textual target cues to frozen grounding models, improving accuracy without retraining.

pa:2610.22990.name: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
pa:2610.22990.desc: PersonaCUABench reveals that computer-use agents frequently fail to satisfy real user requirements and constraints, reducing task completion and satisfaction compared to fixed benchmark instructions.

pa:2610.27100.name: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
pa:2610.27100.desc: Neural generative limit order book models trained for next-token prediction exhibit emergent market impact under metaorder injection, though relaxation decay remains unobserved due to limited context windows.

pa:2610.37626.name: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
pa:2610.37626.desc: A hybrid paradigm combining autoregressive pretraining for semantics and diffusion post-training for rendering achieves efficient, high-quality text-to-image generation with favorable scaling laws.

pa:2610.36095.name: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
pa:2610.36095.desc: Researchers developed a statistical instrument using atomic replacement rules to measure language model instruction capacity with quantified uncertainty, finding GPT-4o mini holds about 37-38 rules at 95% accuracy.

hf:Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex.name: Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex
hf:Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex.zh: Pika 推出的彈性影像生成模型，主打將靜態圖片轉換為動態影片

pa:2610.40647.name: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
pa:2610.40647.desc: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.

pa:2610.40614.name: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
pa:2610.40614.desc: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.

pa:2610.38342.name: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
pa:2610.38342.desc: Investor's Last Exam evaluates financial agents on end-to-end equity research using frozen evidence, expert criteria, and dependency graphs, revealing that top models excel at research but fail at forecasting and investment judgments.

pa:2610.39264.name: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
pa:2610.39264.desc: An online reinforcement learning framework trains UI navigation agents on live mobile apps using a planning agent, UI grounding model, and a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method to improve robustness and reduce inference costs.

pa:2610.40454.name: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
pa:2610.40454.desc: Glance integrates reranking and generation into a single backbone using lightweight adapters and pointer heads to score passages from shared context, reducing memory overhead while improving retrieval and answer quality.

pa:2610.38568.name: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
pa:2610.38568.desc: A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.
pa:2610.38568.zh: 讓AI自己出題練習來變聰明，不需要人類老師給答案
pa:2610.38568.why: 不用靠外部標註資料，AI會自動淘汰學會的題目、挑戰新難題，自己檢驗對錯來提升各項表現

pa:2610.36671.name: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
pa:2610.36671.desc: LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.

pa:2610.21143.name: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
pa:2610.21143.desc: CoSTA decouples generation and synthesis token spaces to accelerate spoken dialogue models while preserving quality and compatibility.

pa:2610.40362.name: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
pa:2610.40362.desc: Effective learning rate trajectories primarily drive weight-normalized training gains, motivating an affine inverse-square-root schedule that improves large-scale pretraining loss and robustness.

pa:2610.40599.name: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
pa:2610.40599.desc: HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.

pa:2610.39633.name: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
pa:2610.39633.desc: Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

pa:2610.39633.why: 改進 AI 畫圖技術，讓它在幾個步驟內就畫出高品質圖片，而且能清楚呈現長篇文字，比以往更快更好

pa:2610.29927.name: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
pa:2610.29927.desc: This work formalizes benchmark evaluation through difficulty measures, identifies failure modes of measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and proposes diagnostic metrics and a rewriting algorithm to improve benchmark coverage.

pa:2610.32411.name: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
pa:2610.32411.desc: Retrieval heads remain sparse and shared across audio-visual modalities, and optimizing them improves document retrieval performance in multimodal models.

pa:2610.38678.desc: Proactive video understanding should include asking for missing information under uncertainty, and the AskStream benchmark reveals current models struggle with this decision.
pa:2610.38678.org: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation

pa:2610.39664.name: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
pa:2610.39664.desc: EditAgent broadens agentic image editing by routing steps to diverse editors and using verification records for listwise judging, improving reliability and efficiency.

pa:2610.38352.name: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
pa:2610.38352.desc: WeVisCut is a script-to-video system that trains a compact policy to coordinate video editing tools, recover from failures, and reduce token usage while maintaining quality.

pa:2610.38425.name: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
pa:2610.38425.desc: IntReal introduces a real-world interleaved multimodal dataset and evaluation framework to diagnose unified model strengths and improve generation through targeted training.

pa:2610.33106.name: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
pa:2610.33106.desc: VibeGame is a framework that uses specialized adversarial agents and an AI-native engine to build complete 2D games from natural-language prompts with interactive validation and self-evolving reusable components.

pa:2610.37786.name: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
pa:2610.37786.desc: WebAnything automates the reconstruction of reusable, source-grounded web environments from real URLs, enabling scalable agent training and evaluation with verified fidelity.

pa:2610.37161.name: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
pa:2610.37161.desc: WorkFactory builds coherent professional tasks via information planning and repair, yielding WorkPilot models that improve expert-level agent performance across benchmarks.

pa:2610.37695.name: After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System
pa:2610.37695.desc: AI-generated video tools shift content production toward service-type material, unbalancing the industry and overwhelming recommendation systems, prompting a dual-judgment BoLe framework to protect work-type content.

pa:2610.39301.desc: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.

pa:2610.39287.name: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation

pa:2610.40453.name: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions

pa:2610.39663.name: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers

pa:2610.38331.name: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right

pa:2610.23656.name: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics

pa:2610.39302.name: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
pa:2610.39302.desc: Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.

pa:2610.40748.desc: WorldBridge improves robot task generalization by combining video prediction with sparse action supervision via separate video and action experts, achieving state-of-the-art results across manipulation benchmarks.

pa:2610.40373.name: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model

pa:2610.37918.desc: Venus-DefakerOne2 is a unified anti-forgery foundation model that extends detection to diverse forgery forms and media types through alternating LoRA and full-parameter tuning and entropy-based test adaptation.

pa:2610.39276.name: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
pa:2610.39276.desc: MemSteer generates evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories to optimize agent memory design without model updates, improving benchmark scores significantly.

pa:2610.40727.name: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
pa:2610.40727.desc: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.

pa:2610.37919.name: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
pa:2610.37919.desc: SciGame evaluates scientific discovery agents using structured cards with counterfactual environments to separate prior knowledge from empirical evidence, revealing that exact symbolic law recovery remains a key challenge.

pa:2610.40914.name: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
pa:2610.40914.desc: Training acceleration in diffusion transformers is driven by reorganization of AdaLN-Zero residual gates, and a simple radial objective promoting broader gate participation improves generation quality without auxiliary teachers.

pa:2610.42053.name: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
pa:2610.42053.desc: REA unifies deliberative and reactive policies in a single runtime with asynchronous coordination, achieving high success rates with reduced control overhead across simulated and real robot tasks.
pa:2610.42053.zh: 讓機器人同時思考與反射動作，靈活完成各種複雜任務

pa:2610.31222.name: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
pa:2610.31222.desc: GLOW-FM is a one-step latent flow-matching framework that enables efficient generative low-light image enhancement via single-function evaluation in a compact latent space.

pa:2610.42149.name: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
pa:2610.42149.desc: LARC enables continuous latent reasoning for unified multimodal models, improving image generation quality and enabling test-time scaling without discrete token bottlenecks.

pa:2610.29617.name: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
pa:2610.29617.desc: TernScope co-designs a compact ternary-weight segmentation network with simplified hardware to achieve high accuracy and fast inference for edge medical imaging.

pa:2610.41260.name: SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement

pa:2610.39086.name: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
pa:2610.39086.desc: HALO introduces a human-annotated benchmark and dataset to evaluate proactive agents, revealing that over-proactivity is the dominant failure mode.

pa:2610.40738.name: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
pa:2610.40738.desc: Apriel Voice 27B Preview is an open speech-language model that integrates speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a shared backbone, achieving strong results on audio benchmarks through a two-stage training procedure with online distillation.

pa:2610.40636.name: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
pa:2610.40636.desc: Visual foundation models vary in supporting persistent spatial states across structure, persistence, prediction, and action, with readout accuracy not guaranteeing history-based updates or reliable goal-directed progress.

pa:2610.40945.name: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.40945.desc: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models suffers from training-inference mismatch due to numerical discrepancies and policy lag, and a derived discrepancy-lag correction stabilizes training by centering errors, clipping importance ratios, and resynchronizing sampling.

pa:2610.40799.name: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
pa:2610.40799.desc: CaPtain trains small open vision-language models via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning with a physical critic to perform robot manipulation through code, achieving strong results without frontier models or vision-language-action backbones.

pa:2610.42141.name: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
pa:2610.42141.desc: RoboArchitect automates robot harness design by iteratively revising control code around a frozen policy, substantially improving success on unseen scenes and tasks without model updates.

pa:2610.42096.name: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
pa:2610.42096.desc: Causal World Action Models enforce sparse routing to isolate action-relevant latent variables, ensuring identifiable causal structure without requiring temporal independence assumptions.

pa:2610.16927.name: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
pa:2610.16927.desc: WeFair improves personalized query rewriting via fidelity-aware human feedback stages—demonstration, preference, and verification—to reduce intent drift and boost search effectiveness in short-video platforms.

pa:2610.36545.name: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
pa:2610.36545.desc: FrameForge enables adaptive conditional image generation by modeling variable condition-target relationships through dynamic temporal experts and intermediate reasoning pathways in pretrained video models.

pa:2610.35850.desc: OSWAM enables real-time, high-quality action generation in autonomous driving and embodied control by initializing diffusion with structured imagination tokens and distilling future-conditioned privileged information into a single denoising step.

pa:2610.37903.name: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
pa:2610.37903.desc: Metis-1.6 introduces small, efficient mixture-of-experts language models trained with limited data that achieve competitive math performance and Pareto-optimal efficiency despite training errors and architectural issues.

pa:2610.42010.name: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
pa:2610.42010.desc: TurnTurk-GPT, a Turkish turn-taking predictor fine-tuned from GPT-2, outperforms multilingual detectors and reveals that Turkish end-of-turn cues rely on verb-final morphology.

pa:2610.40256.name: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
pa:2610.40256.desc: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes complex, interdependent software development tasks with verified tests to train coding agents, improving performance on long-horizon benchmarks.

pa:2610.37393.name: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
pa:2610.37393.desc: Quality-Controllable Policy enables real-time adjustment of robot execution quality and improves performance through iterative hindsight relabeling of online rollouts.

pa:2610.34926.name: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
pa:2610.34926.desc: Visible-State Supervision and Test-Time Causal View Search improve streaming action recognition by separating representation learning from evidence selection, boosting accuracy with fewer frames.

sp:hide1/MOSS-Image-Character-Catalog.name: hide1/MOSS-Image-Character-Catalog
sp:hide1/MOSS-Image-Character-Catalog.zh: 影像角色目錄展示工具

pa:2610.36384.name: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
pa:2610.36384.desc: SOMA is a benchmark assessing fine-grained egocentric body-motion reasoning in multimodal models, revealing substantial gaps versus human performance and providing training data and a multimodal baseline to advance the field.

pa:2610.37651.name: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
pa:2610.37651.desc: GEPA-Curator improves agentic prompt optimization by filtering unreliable failure signals and retrieving past successes, boosting performance across multiple benchmarks.

pa:2610.41278.name: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
pa:2610.41278.desc: AuditFL is a blockchain-backed clearing layer that makes federated learning rounds auditable and economically constrained without removing the aggregator, preserving model accuracy under failures.

pa:2610.37481.name: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
pa:2610.37481.desc: SimpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.

pa:2610.40488.name: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
pa:2610.40488.desc: Frontier AI research agents propose many sound experiments but show limited ability to rank them better than simple baselines, with teams offering no clear quality gains.

pa:2610.41216.name: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
pa:2610.41216.desc: TinyAstral improves robot agent harnesses via recursive self-improvement and distills compact students that retain performance gains with lower compute.

pa:2610.27954.name: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
pa:2610.27954.desc: ReTrace is a framework that evaluates recovery behavior in computer-use agents by formalizing transition-consistent recovery and demonstrating that autonomous model-based recovery improves long-horizon reliability.

pa:2610.40191.name: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
pa:2610.40191.desc: Agent harnesses integrate video generation and world models to enable planning, tool use, and recursive self-improvement for autonomous multi-shot video production.
pa:2610.40191.zh: 結合影片生成與規劃能力，讓 AI 能自動完成複雜的影片製作
pa:2610.40191.why: 讓 AI 不只是生成畫面，還能像導演一樣規劃鏡頭並自我修正，產出連貫影片

pa:2610.39419.name: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
pa:2610.39419.desc: Multimodal language models fail at multi-step visual reasoning due to a reference gap rather than perception, and task-matched external references like numbering significantly improve accuracy without training.

pa:2611.00172.name: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
pa:2611.00172.desc: Embedding research across modalities is converging toward shared principles via contrastive learning and Transformers, and a framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality is proposed to unify it through transformation, alignment, and joint embedding.

pa:2610.40293.name: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
pa:2610.40293.desc: MAServeBench evaluates LLM serving and hardware by modeling multi-agent collaboration as a configurable workload dimension with reproducible dependency traces.

pa:2610.38637.name: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
pa:2610.38637.desc: Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation improves on-policy self-distillation by continuously enhancing self-teaching reliability through reward-guided teacher optimization and adaptive down-weighting of unreliable samples.

pa:2610.41296.name: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
pa:2610.41296.desc: Auxiliary trajectory preferences based on entropy and confidence metrics improve small language model self-improvement and transfer by distinguishing learning value among equally correct reasoning traces.

pa:2610.27815.name: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
pa:2610.27815.desc: ProVe reverses speculative decoding roles by fine-tuning a large model to propose token blocks and verifying them with a smaller or identical model, achieving faster autoregressive generation with adjustable speed-accuracy tradeoffs.

pa:2610.42128.name: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
pa:2610.42128.desc: DecisionRank uses item-space on-policy distillation to transfer ranking knowledge from generative teachers to efficient decision models, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval performance with significantly faster inference.

pa:2610.37826.name: DeFT-RAG: Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
pa:2610.37826.desc: DeFT-RAG improves multi-hop question answering by generating self-contained sub-questions sequentially, offloading reasoning to rule-based updates and a lightweight decision model, and caching answers to reduce LLM usage.

pa:2610.40901.name: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
pa:2610.40901.desc: TSFLab is a self-improving agent-agnostic workbench that equips coding agents with shared resources to reduce costs and automate maintenance for time series forecasting research and benchmarking.

hf:nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-NVFP4.zh: 輝達推出的量化版深度求索模型，代表硬體大廠對頂尖開源模型的極致優化與推論加速
hf:nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-NVFP4.why: NVIDIA 將最新開源模型進行 NVFP4 極致量化，顯示晶片巨頭正直接加速主流大模型落地，降

sp:townbox/motionbricks-playground.name: townbox/motionbricks-playground
sp:townbox/motionbricks-playground.zh: 動作區塊生成與互動展示空間

pa:2611.01460.name: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
pa:2611.01460.desc: Tutorial Agentic Learning enables LLM agents to continuously learn from instructional videos without parameter updates by building a structured tutorialbook memory and retrieving via reasoning-linked table-of-contents trees.

pa:2611.00053.name: SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time
pa:2611.00053.desc: SIMIT is a test-time framework that lets vision-language models generate their own practice data to improve answers on unlabeled queries without external annotations.

pa:2611.00074.name: When Morphs Look Better: Face Image Quality as a Training-Free Signal for Morphing Attack Detection
pa:2611.00074.desc: Face image quality assessment methods vary widely in detecting diffusion-based and other morphing attacks, with performance depending heavily on attack type and dataset, and high quality scores for morphs often indicate poor detection.

pa:2610.39278.name: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
pa:2610.39278.desc: WorldFlow is a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and 3D trajectories using continuous displacement tokens and a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone, improving physical dynamics prediction across diverse benchmarks.

pa:2611.03219.name: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
pa:2611.03219.desc: Empirical study shows continual harness self-evolution across software engineering tasks causes severe catastrophic forgetting, with performance on earlier datasets dropping sharply after later evolution.

pa:2611.02928.name: Lab2Sim: Turning Real-World Experiment Videos into Interactive Virtual Experiments
pa:2611.02928.desc: Lab2Sim introduces a benchmark for converting science videos into interactive virtual experiments, and EduVideo2Code improves apparatus fidelity by encoding procedures as state machines for verified code generation.

pa:2611.03344.name: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
pa:2611.03344.desc: FLAMIA accelerates Transformer attention on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs via MXFP8 and mixed-precision kernels that reduce quantization overhead, prevent causal leakage, and support variable-length packed documents.

pa:2611.02633.name: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
pa:2611.02633.desc: The Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark evaluates AI agents as teammates across 240 tasks, revealing that even top models have significant collaboration weaknesses unrelated to individual capability.

pa:2611.03602.name: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
pa:2611.03602.desc: Reviso is an agentic video captioning framework that learns to prioritize key visual evidence through hierarchical planning and active perception, improving caption quality and downstream video understanding.

pa:2611.03178.name: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
pa:2611.03178.desc: CoworkOS is a long-horizon agent harness that separates strategy from execution, supports human-in-the-loop collaboration via shared artifacts, and improves model performance through sustained automated post-training.
pa:2611.03178.zh: 把AI變身可靠職場同事，搞定複雜工作
pa:2611.03178.why: 它把大腦思考與實際做事分開，還能跟人類合作並自我學習，比以往更能處理長期的複雜任務

pa:2610.41574.name: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
pa:2610.41574.desc: BYOD converts autoregressive language models into diffusion models via parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, enabling parallel generation with minimal training cost while preserving base-model knowledge.

pa:2611.03526.name: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
pa:2611.03526.desc: Library of Layers dynamically orders transformer blocks during inference to adapt computation to tasks, enabling parameter reuse, sparsity, and interpretable routing across reasoning, multilingual, and safety settings.

pa:2611.01484.name: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
pa:2611.01484.desc: CrossSWE introduces a multi-repository benchmark showing that current LLMs struggle with cross-repository consistency during joint software development.

pa:2611.03126.name: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
pa:2611.03126.desc: CUA-Master uses nested recursive loops with open-world data and feedback-driven retries to continuously improve computer-use agents across diverse benchmarks.
pa:2611.03126.zh: 讓AI學會自己操作電腦，透過不斷自我反省來變得更聰明
pa:2611.03126.why: 讓AI在開放環境中像真人一樣使用電腦，遇到錯誤會自動重試並修正，比以往的系統更不容易失敗

pa:2611.03092.name: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
pa:2611.03092.desc: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over c

pa:2611.01560.name: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
pa:2611.01560.desc: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.

pa:2611.02102.name: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
pa:2611.02102.desc: NorthCUA scales computer-use agents via an experience flywheel, recursive self-improvement, staged learning, and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art open-source GUI and web interaction results.

pa:2611.00859.name: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
pa:2611.00859.desc: Wave Forcing enables efficient continuous long-video generation with consistent appearance and natural motion through co-designed generation, training, and execution, achieving high throughput and quality.
pa:2611.00859.zh: 讓影片生成速度變超快，還能保持畫面流暢自然
pa:2611.00859.why: 突破長影片生成的卡頓問題，大幅提升生成速度與畫面穩定度，不用久等就能看見高品質影片

gh:spotify/portal-ai-plugins.zh: Spotify 開源的 AI 插件開發工具

gh:Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor.name: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
gh:Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor.desc: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品
gh:Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor.zh: 基於 Playwright 的二手平台監控系統

sp:hyz317/HairDeck.name: hyz317/HairDeck
sp:hyz317/HairDeck.zh: 基於 Gradio 的 AI 髮型設計互動介面

pa:2611.02112.name: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
pa:2611.02112.desc: Order-only on-policy distillation trains students to match teacher token rankings rather than probabilities, improving reasoning performance without temperature tuning.

pa:2610.32878.name: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
pa:2610.32878.desc: Layer-wise error modeling and token-wise Fisher statistics improve low-rank SVD compression of large language models by refining rank allocation and decomposition quality.

pa:2610.41994.name: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
pa:2610.41994.desc: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization improves long-context retrieval in gated linear recurrent models by jointly configuring decay and sensitivity parameters before training.

pa:2611.03097.name: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
pa:2611.03097.desc: DR Pixel is an open-source multimodal agent that performs deep research directly on rendered document page images, improving retrieval and reasoning over scientific papers through counterfactual credit reweighting.

pa:2610.38623.name: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
pa:2610.38623.desc: Jev's cross-primitive consistency is benchmarked and improved via a residual calibrator that reduces inconsistency and boosts decision accuracy.

pa:2610.35219.name: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
pa:2610.35219.desc: MACR introduces a relay-based multi-agent framework that dynamically transfers reasoning between agents using confidence-guided triggering and bidding to improve accuracy with lower token overhead.

pa:2610.39639.name: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
pa:2610.39639.desc: Vision-language models often judge 3D object properties correctly but fail to recover and consistently apply exact per-color counts, motivating evaluation by exact correctness, consistency, and visual dependence.

pa:2611.02074.name: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
pa:2611.02074.desc: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.

pa:2611.02332.name: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
pa:2611.02332.desc: LeanGuard is a verified runtime that blocks policy-violating tool calls by language-model agents and can repair them via proof-guided search, reducing unauthorized executions and prompt-injection success without harming benign task performance.

pa:2611.01860.name: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
pa:2611.01860.desc: This report proposes a unified taxonomy and literature system for agentic computer graphics driven by large language models, analyzing trends and open challenges in human-agent collaboration and long-horizon planning.
pa:2611.01860.zh: 用大白話整理AI操作電腦繪圖的最新發展與挑戰
pa:2611.01860.why: 系統化整理AI幫忙畫圖的研究方向，讓大家看懂目前技術卡在哪裡又該怎麼突破

pa:2611.01815.name: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
pa:2611.01815.desc: The study evaluates frozen video representations to show that prediction errors reflect appearance and motion rather than reliably measuring physical surprise.

pa:2611.03393.name: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
pa:2611.03393.desc: An audio-guided framework restores facial details in AI-generated videos by combining reference-guided flow modeling with audio synchronization to resolve lip and dental ambiguity.

pa:2611.02897.name: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
pa:2611.02897.desc: PhotoGuider selects viewing directions and frames 360° panoramas using shared composition-aware tokens and produces camera-parameter outputs with explanation-conditioned scoring.

sp:Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air.name: Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air
sp:Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air.zh: 基於 Gradio 的真實感語音合成展示應用

pa:2611.02782.name: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
pa:2611.02782.desc: History Forcing improves long-range consistency in few-step autoregressive video generation by using historical context residuals to correct distillation targets.

pa:2611.03424.name: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
pa:2611.03424.desc: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.
pa:2611.03424.org: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science

sp:PrunaAI/P-H3-Image.zh: 未知團隊的測試性質圖像處理展示

pa:2611.04467.name: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
pa:2611.04467.desc: Cross-pathway concept unlearning in unified multimodal models is addressed by a new benchmark and method that jointly suppresses target concept generation and recognition while preserving other capabilities.
pa:2611.04467.org: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation

pa:2611.02244.name: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
pa:2611.02244.desc: AI reviewers often fail to reflect manuscript improvements in scores, with user opinions frequently overriding observed revision gains.

pa:2610.00854.name: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
pa:2610.00854.desc: Frontier vision-language models vary widely in embodied task performance, with closed-weight systems leading in planning and manipulation while open-weight models lag, and failure patterns reveal distinct geometric, control, and reasoning errors rather than uniform deficits.
pa:2610.00854.zh: 測試多模態AI當機器人腦袋的實戰表現
pa:2610.00854.why: 分析現有AI在機器人控制上的強項與盲點，發現閉源模型在規劃與操作上表現較好

pa:2611.03747.name: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
pa:2611.03747.desc: A retrieval-augmented generation system for stock market queries improves response accuracy and speed, validated by high ROUGE scores and low latency.

pa:2611.04916.name: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
pa:2611.04916.desc: Kling's multimodal understanding stack links caption density, perceptual text encoding, reward modeling, and evaluation protocols to improve controllable video generation.

pa:2611.04449.name: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
pa:2611.04449.desc: Near-zero input embeddings in untied gated language models cause extreme gradient amplification and training instability, which is addressed by GroupClip and GateFloor remedies.

pa:2611.03685.name: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
pa:2611.03685.desc: LOLPlay evaluates visual agents on real-time League of Legends tasks, finding that increased reasoning effort does not improve success and can reduce interaction time.

pa:2610.39251.name: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
pa:2610.39251.desc: A two-stage adaptive framework improves multi-step GUI agent training by using intermediate checkpoints and selective rollout ranges to reduce environment interactions while boosting performance.

pa:2611.04870.name: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
pa:2611.04870.desc: PrimeSim is an action-conditioned multiview world model that uses progressive training, unified action representations, view-aware attention, and hierarchical memory to enable consistent, long-horizon robot simulation and policy optimization.

pa:2610.40747.name: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
pa:2610.40747.desc: Mage-VL-Cowork is a 4B hybrid computer-use agent trained via a progressive curriculum and scalable synthetic data generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on OSWorld-Verified with efficient reasoning.

pa:2611.04035.name: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
pa:2611.04035.desc: Recursa is a self-improving foundation model system that adapts to new domains by recursively learning from its own experience, storing skills and reflections in a knowledge repository, and validating improvements without human supervision or stronger teachers.

pa:2611.02501.name: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
pa:2611.02501.desc: SpecPilot autonomously discovers deployment-specific algorithms and system optimizations to maximize speculative decoding speedups across diverse models, drafters, and serving regimes without quality loss.

pa:2611.02079.name: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
pa:2611.02079.desc: ParetoSaddler improves LLM agent harnesses by separately promoting intermediate candidates via Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support and selecting final deployments, boosting quality while reducing cost.

pa:2611.02737.name: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
pa:2611.02737.desc: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for long-form multi-shot video editing that uses cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling and a new benchmark to maintain coherence across scenes while reducing manual data annotation.
pa:2611.02737.zh: 簡化長篇多鏡頭影片的剪輯流程，保持畫面風格與內容連貫
pa:2611.02737.why: 解決長影片剪輯時容易畫面不連貫的問題，大幅減少人工手動調整的時間

pa:2611.02568.name: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
pa:2611.02568.desc: SeMo3D unifies 3D generation, editing, and completion through selective region modeling, using region-selective denoising and a multi-condition diffusion transformer to preserve unchanged content and enable training without paired data.

pa:2611.02497.name: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
pa:2611.02497.desc: RoboColosseum evaluates general robot policies across diverse embodiments and environments, revealing weak cross-embodiment agreement, limited open-world reliability, and substantial differences between zero-shot and fine-tuned performance.

pa:2611.01120.name: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
pa:2611.01120.desc: StreamDuo pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that retrieves game wiki entries to improve cross-game streaming commentary without training on target games.

pa:2610.38252.name: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
pa:2610.38252.desc: This monograph surveys neural methods for music audio generation, covering codecs, autoregressive and diffusion models, flow matching, preference optimization, evaluation practices, and legal considerations.

hf:nvidia/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE.name: nvidia/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE
hf:nvidia/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE.zh: 輝達推出的語音到語音處理模型

pa:2611.04785.name: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
pa:2611.04785.desc: Kierston and KierstonBench provide a simulated city-scale environment to evaluate large language models on criminal investigation tasks using linked surveillance records, revealing that only frontier models perform reliably while remaining vulnerable to deception.

pa:2611.05193.name: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
pa:2611.05193.desc: FactEmbed improves composed image retrieval by decoupling query understanding from embedding construction through factorized latents that simulate visual modifications before retrieval.

pa:2611.04814.name: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
pa:2611.04814.desc: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

pa:2611.05306.name: You don't need long context
pa:2611.05306.desc: Frequent context compaction preserves task accuracy across long-horizon and long-input tasks, suggesting that long-context language models may be unnecessary and motivating semantic state space models.

pa:2611.02476.name: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
pa:2611.02476.desc: GigaSpeech 3 provides 39,000 hours of weakly transcribed dialectal Arabic speech, enabling improved recognition across five dialects via self-supervised labeling and noisy-student refinement.
pa:2611.02476.org: SJTU Cross Media Language Intelligence Lab

pa:2610.37914.name: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
pa:2610.37914.desc: Using Muon to train mixture-of-experts language models increases routing imbalance in early layers, which can be mitigated by centering router inputs or reducing the optimizer learning rate.

pa:2611.03183.name: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
pa:2611.03183.desc: An autonomous agent adaptively designs target-specific multiple sequence alignments for AlphaFold 3 by reasoning over biological hypotheses and self-directed experimentation, improving protein interface prediction with fewer sequences.

pa:2611.03360.name: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
pa:2611.03360.desc: Kev-Bio is a vision-language model that guides ultrasound landmark detection via clinical questions, generating spatial probability maps to derive measurements with reduced operator variability.

pa:2611.05377.name: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
pa:2611.05377.desc: DreamX leverages a pretrained video diffusion model to learn compact, appearance-invariant latent actions that enable cross-embodiment transfer and efficient policy learning.

pa:2611.04418.name: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
pa:2611.04418.desc: VidUEU-Agent automates instruction data synthesis from raw videos via a multi-stage pipeline with autonomous iteration, yielding a 100K-sample dataset that improves multimodal model performance.

pa:2611.05255.name: Going Deeper With Memories
pa:2611.05255.desc: DeepMem is a causal multiscale byte-level architecture that uses invertible subband transforms and fast weight memory to compress sequences for efficient reasoning while preserving exact byte identity via lossless carriers and attention-based super-resolution decoding.

pa:2611.05163.name: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
pa:2611.05163.desc: RoboTryOn translates human demonstration videos into robot videos to train control policies without real robot demonstrations, improving success rates and reducing data collection costs.

pa:2611.02017.name: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
pa:2611.02017.desc: A benchmark for resuming interrupted software tasks reveals performance drops from interleaved work, and a context-management module improves recovery.

pa:2610.39813.name: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
pa:2610.39813.desc: EvoTeam evolves multi-agent collaboration by jointly adapting team organization, interaction rules, and agent skills through execution experience while maintaining reusable team libraries.

pa:2611.04303.name: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
pa:2611.04303.desc: FlowTranslator is a training-free framework for in-image machine translation that uses diffusion trajectory controls to generate accurate translated text within images without paired training data.

pa:2611.05036.name: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2611.05036.desc: ToolSpace constructs realistic multi-environment tool-use benchmarks by mining execution traces, clustering tool compositions, and validating tasks through replayable state-aware random walks.

pa:2610.36915.name: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
pa:2610.36915.desc: Typed decision models classify source-conflict types faster and cheaper than frontier LLMs, with cascades matching top accuracy at lower cost, though they vary in sensitivity and false-source detection.

pa:2611.01927.name: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks
pa:2611.01927.desc: DEPTH generates complex terminal tasks by measuring sequential dependency depth rather than turn count, producing harder benchmarks that improve agent fine-tuning.

pa:2611.03634.name: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
pa:2611.03634.desc: WebHarbor provides 153 executable, dockerized web environments for stable evaluation and reinforcement learning training of GUI agents, enabling strong generalization across multi-step and post-authentication tasks.

pa:2610.39714.name: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
pa:2610.39714.desc: MoLRSI is an AI agent that optimizes molecular design workflows and retains cross-task memory to improve search policies, achieving higher experimental hit rates in antibiotic and peptide binder discovery than expert-led methods.

pa:2611.05280.name: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
pa:2611.05280.desc: YANAMI introduces a large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, requiring models to track and realize evolving dialogue states across turns, and reveals that current unified multimodal models still struggle with this task.

pa:2611.00617.name: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
pa:2611.00617.desc: Pandora is a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models evolving psychological and relational states to generate more authentic, individually aligned expressions and reduce AI-like responses.
pa:2611.00617.zh: 模擬真實病患的心理狀態，讓心理諮商 AI 對話更像真人

pa:2611.05275.name: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
pa:2611.05275.desc: Route Anything is a framework for dynamically selecting and coordinating specialized AI models and policies across diverse tasks to improve performance and efficiency.

pa:2611.03233.name: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
pa:2611.03233.desc: Axion 1.0 is an open agent foundation model trained via a concise three-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, achieving competitive agentic performance while fully releasing its data and training recipe.

pa:2610.40753.name: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
pa:2610.40753.desc: Caper pre-executes shell commands in isolated sandboxes to evaluate real-world effects before approval, reducing harmful outcomes compared to text-based approvers.

pa:2610.41366.name: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
pa:2610.41366.desc: Comparing replacement operators for pruned mixture-of-experts experts reveals that gate scaling and calibration domain strongly affect performance, with a proposed tilted novice operator improving results without dominating all settings.

pa:2611.05345.desc: Speculative decoding can be trained to reject critical reasoning tokens so they are verified by the target model, reducing numerical noise and improving long-horizon agent accuracy without altering the target model.

pa:2611.03806.name: BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
pa:2611.03806.desc: BEND 2.0 evaluates DNA language models on predicting mutation effects and guiding sequence design, revealing that linear readouts and post-training improve performance but context-specific and multi-objective design remain challenging.

pa:2611.03998.desc: Dory1.0-4B is a 4-billion-parameter recurrent language model with elastic depth that improves accuracy and token efficiency by looping a shared block, outperforming larger models on multiple benchmarks.

pa:2610.35497.desc: Fine-grained process rewards improve long-horizon video editing tasks but cause reward hacking in shorter tasks, which is mitigated by decaying their weight, while on-policy self-distillation provides little benefit.

pa:2611.00352.name: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
pa:2611.00352.desc: Hidden-state reuse across factual questions partially transfers relation-specific answer shifts in small language models, with effectiveness depending on format, cohort, and source relation alignment.

pa:2611.04414.name: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
pa:2611.04414.desc: SphereFlow projects modalities onto a shared hypersphere to enable short-range cross-modal imputation via flow matching with geometry-aware noise and decoder modifications.

pa:2611.04169.name: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
pa:2611.04169.desc: In retrieval tasks, language model failure on long inputs stems from attention competition rather than sequence length, as rival evidence statements sharply reduce accuracy while neutral filler does not.

pa:2611.01598.name: QFabric: Guarded Cross-Domain Task Recovery and Its Limits on a Linux-RTOS Board
pa:2611.01598.desc: QFabric demonstrates that migrating tasks to a microcontroller on heterogeneous boards fails to isolate them from Linux interference, emphasizing that guarded recovery mechanisms are essential to prevent harmful migrations.

pa:2611.06796.desc: Velocity Adversarial Distillation and trajectory-aware supervision enable high-quality few-step diffusion and flow generation with state-of-the-art results.

pa:2611.06083.name: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
pa:2611.06083.desc: SleuthVLM uses a vision-language model with transcribed speech and autonomous video sleuthing to outperform direct audio-hearing omni models on long-video benchmarks, showing that agentic reasoning matters more than auditory input.

pa:2611.03228.name: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
pa:2611.03228.desc: AnchorComplete reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds by combining partial-point conditioning with metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, improving reconstruction under sparse views.

pa:2611.06918.name: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
pa:2611.06918.desc: NEO-VLA eliminates fixed visual encoders to let action policies access evolving visual representations across network depths, improving manipulation robustness.

pa:2610.40516.name: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
pa:2610.40516.desc: Researchers developed a scalable template-based pipeline to generate multilingual safety datasets, revealing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual model safety and that culturally localized training improves alignment across languages.

pa:2611.05320.name: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
pa:2611.05320.desc: A coding agent automates robot demonstration generation by simulating tasks, rendering photorealistic videos, and producing deployable training data at lower cost than teleoperation.

pa:2611.02857.name: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
pa:2611.02857.desc: Solv3R is a looped transformer that iteratively refines multi-view geometry from its current state, supporting incremental updates, caching, and multiple reconstruction tasks without specialized modules.

pa:2611.02846.name: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
pa:2611.02846.desc: SpecOPD accelerates speculative decoding by parallelizing on-policy draft supervision across independent branches, improving acceptance length and training throughput across diverse model architectures and tasks.

pa:2611.04634.name: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
pa:2611.04634.desc: VeriSpoof is an audio language model that unifies deepfake detection, generator attribution, source verification, and evidence-based rationale generation with minimal parameter updates.

pa:2611.04391.name: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
pa:2611.04391.desc: H2RB adapts pretrained vision-language-action policies to new robots using unpaired human demonstrations via geometry-anchored alignment and a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, substantially improving cross-embodiment skill transfer.

pa:2610.37257.name: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
pa:2610.37257.desc: GameVerse is a large-scale gameplay dataset with minute-long sequences and event-aligned annotations that improves long-horizon interactive world modeling.

pa:2611.04166.name: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
pa:2611.04166.desc: Visual perturbations can alter physical actions in vision-language-action models while leaving rationales unchanged, demonstrating that unchanged reasoning does not guarantee safe actions.

pa:2611.01621.name: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
pa:2611.01621.desc: FinForesight is a diagnostic backtesting benchmark that evaluates financial deep research forecasting under time-restricted retrieval and compares historical, post-cutoff, and live performance.

pa:2610.41432.name: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
pa:2610.41432.desc: Hybrid Computer Use unifies programmatic, accessibility-based, and visual interaction channels to improve agent efficiency and success on complex desktop tasks.

pa:2611.06768.name: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
pa:2611.06768.desc: PyRUA-REAL enables coding agents to convert physical robot exploration into persistent executable skills, achieving high success rates across real-world and benchmark tasks through recursive self-improvement.

pa:2611.04760.name: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
pa:2611.04760.desc: KGO unifies structured latent dynamics with single-step flow matching and adaptive uncertainty gating to achieve accurate, efficient probabilistic time-series forecasting.

pa:2611.03404.name: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
pa:2611.03404.desc: VidDub is a two-step diffusion video dubbing model that uses replacement-aware cross-audio supervision to avoid conflicting source-mouth targets and achieves strong lip synchronization with high visual fidelity.

pa:2611.04949.desc: HERIT adapts machine translation to historical archives via retrieval-augmented pseudo-labeling, improving accuracy across time periods and unlocking global access.

pa:2611.05029.name: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
pa:2611.05029.desc: DRAP improves replay-free continual learning for physical AI by adaptively reducing plasticity of critical model components based on trajectory-amplification risk, enhancing retention of past behaviors without sacrificing new task learning.

pa:2611.05988.name: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
pa:2611.05988.desc: LiveFoley improves streaming video-to-audio generation by using a trailing sliding window for visual alignment and expanded temporal denoising windows for audio quality with minimal latency.
